newsitems.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 - Upcoming Deep Dives
newsitems.author: FC_Rileyy
newsitems.contents: Welcome to the road to EA SPORTS FC™ 27.Over the coming weeks, we'll be releasing a series of Deep Dives and Pitch Notes from the development team. Ahead of launch, these will be joined by additional Deep Dives, including a dedicated PC Deep Dive. More details can be found below.The Pitch Notes will cover everything coming to Gameplay, Career, Ultimate Team, The Grounds and Clubs in FC 27, including features and improvements driven by community feedback.Upcoming Deep DivesJulyGameplayCareerAugustUltimate TeamThe GroundsClubsPC Deep DiveAlongside the Deep Dives above, we'll also be publishing a dedicated PC-focused Pitch Notes article ahead of launch. This will cover topics specific to the PC version of EA SPORTS FC™ 27, including system requirements, supported features, and platform-specific improvements.Thank you for joining us on the journey to FC 27. We look forward to hearing your feedback as each Deep Dive is released.The EA SPORTS FC Community Team

newsitems.title: Pre-purchase EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Plus Edition
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents: Welcome to The World’s Game. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay. Pre-purchase EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Plus Edition by 31 August to receive 10,000 FC Points across 5 months, Seasons 1 to 5 of the Premium Pass, a Football Ultimate Team™ Player Evolution for EA SPORTS FC™ 26, and more.
